newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Nirma gains after surge in net.
newsitem.headline: India's Nirma gains after surge in net.

text.p: Shares of soap and detergent maker Nirma Ltd rose 37 rupees, or 9.9 percent, to 409 on the Bombay bourse on Wednesday after the firm announced improved results for the year ended March, traders said.
Nirma said on Tuesday its net profit climbed 111 percent to 1.06 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March), from 502.6 million in the previous year.
The results included the operations of Nirma Detergents, Nirma Soaps & Detergents and Shiva Soaps and Detergents, which were merged into Nirma Ltd, the Economic Times newspaper said.
